items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: And he was in the band.

ctx.x: His technique, terrific. He sounds -- when he played the clarinet it sounded like the wind was blowing, ffhvoo, ffhvoo, you know? The guy was something.

Andy Gumps -- that was his nickname. We used to call him. Oh, he was a heck of a guy. And he was in the band. Who else? Can I think? Well, that's all the saxophone players that I can name right off, right off.
Was this a traveling band, Herman, or did you stay in --
